statutes.title: Constitutional Prohibition of Personal Income Tax
text_en: Prohibits any tax upon the income of natural persons who are residents or citizens of Florida, guaranteeing the absence of state individual income taxation.
text_es: Prohíbe constitucionalmente cualquier impuesto sobre el ingreso de personas naturales residentes o ciudadanas de Florida, garantizando la ausencia de impuesto estatal sobre ingresos individuales.

statutes.title: Manifesting and Evidencing Domicile in Florida
text_en: Authorizes any person who has established a domicile in Florida to manifest that domicile by filing a sworn, notarized statement of domicile with the clerk of the circuit court in the county of residence.
text_es: Autoriza a toda persona que haya establecido domicilio en Florida a manifestarlo formalmente mediante declaración jurada radicada ante el secretario del tribunal de circuito del condado correspondiente.

statutes.title: Exemption of Homesteads
text_en: Grants up to $50,000 homestead property tax exemption to persons who maintain permanent residence. Claiming Florida homestead establishes prima facie proof of Florida domicile.
text_es: Concede hasta $50,000 de exención contributiva sobre la propiedad principal a residentes permanentes. Solicitar la exención de 'homestead' constituye prueba prima facie de domicilio en Florida.
